hero.title: Local-First Desktop Software & Enterprise WordPress Plugins
hero.subtitle: VibePress Studio engineers local-first desktop applications and enterprise-grade WordPress performance plugins built on high-throughput native engines to replace bloated SaaS systems with rock-solid, production-grade tools.

pillars.title: Native Architecture & Zero Query Bloat
pillars.desc: Built natively upon standard database tables (wp_posts & wp_postmeta / local database) with 24h transient caching, preserving sub-millisecond execution speeds.

pillars.title: Automated Compliance & Ban Protection
pillars.desc: Smart ToS Uncloaking automatically detects Amazon and eBay links to keep accounts safe under Amazon §6, paired with accessible FTC disclosure banners.

pillars.title: Dynamic Routing & Cinema Proxies
pillars.desc: Route visitors dynamically by OS, device, browser, or language, run weighted A/B split tests, and generate studio ProRes/DNxHR proxies for cinema footage.

pillars.title: 100% Local Data Sovereignty & Defense
pillars.desc: Zero-cloud desktop asset management with BLAKE3 bit-by-bit binary checksum verification, 3-2-1 backup drive mirroring, and GDPR anonymization.

flagship.title: Production-Grade Software Solutions
flagship.subtitle: Explore our suite of flagship WordPress plugins and local-first desktop applications designed for maximum performance, compliance, and complete data ownership.

standards.title: Built to Highest Industry Engineering Standards

items.heading: Native Core Standards & Desktop Engine
items.body: Engineered in strict adherence to WordPress Core Coding Standards (WPCS), PSR-4 patterns, desktop architecture, and high-performance ingestion engines.

items.heading: Enterprise Performance & Verification
items.body: Powered by top-priority rewrite rules, 24h transient caching, optimized local databases, and real-time BLAKE3 bit-by-bit checksum validation.

items.heading: Data Privacy & 100% Offline Security
items.body: Zero third-party cloud tracking pixels, optional IPv4/IPv6 IP anonymization, EXIF privacy scrubbing, and 100% local database ownership.
